blurb: Guests can take PADI scuba diving courses from beginner to rescue diver levels, rent diving equipment, and have their dive gear serviced or repaired. Courses include classroom, pool, and open water sessions with required materials and equipment rental options. The shop also provides air and gas fills for dive tanks meeting safety standards.
